suggested_services_note: Each row is one way this kind of work takes money (one of the master's 28 paths per flow). The owner keeps the services that fit and picks ONE path per service and place. Names and amounts are examples from the profession file, not prices.

suggested_services.name: Group beginner lesson
suggested_services.example: The main story: Alex's group beginner lesson at the beach stand, $85 a person, paid in full when booking. A kids' lesson and a paddle session are paid this way too. A late cancel or a no-show: the price may be kept only with the owner's yes.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson
suggested_services.example: A private lesson at the beach: a card is saved for the $40 fee, and the lesson is paid at the stand. A late cancel or no-show: the $40 fee, only with the owner's yes.

suggested_services.name: Private lesson at your place
suggested_services.example: The main story: a private lesson for a family of 4 at a rental house, $160, with a card saved for the $40 fee; the $160 is charged when the instructor texts DONE. A late cancel or nobody there: the $40, only with the owner's OK.

suggested_services.name: Beach party lesson
suggested_services.example: A beach party lesson for up to 6 people, $420, paid in full when booking.

before_times: how many surfers, and their ages (children's lessons are for ages 8 to 12)
has the surfer tried surfing or paddling before (sets the level and the group)
for a lesson at a customer's place: the address, the beach they want and the area
after_time: board and wetsuit sizes, to lend
anything the instructor should know: a fear of the water, a health need, a language
secure_page_only: each surfer's name, age and a waiver, read and signed
health notes: heart, asthma, a seizure or a recent surgery, and any medicine they carry
a swimming level the instructor should know
for a child: the parent or guardian's OK and who may pick them up
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child under 18 (children 8 to 12 in group lessons; teens 13 to 17 with a guardian's OK); children under 8 are booked with a parent on the sand

stop.words: someone not breathing or unresponsive in the water right now, or a child who can't get a breath
stop.say: Call 911 now. Start rescue breathing or CPR, and call for the lifeguard.

go_on.words: a heart condition, asthma, a recent surgery, or pregnancy
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the instructor reads it before the lesson; Rosie gives no health advice

go_on.words: a surfer afraid of the water
go_on.what: the booking goes on; the instructor starts on the sand, and nobody is pushed into the water

steps.name: Waiver on the secure page
steps.who: every surfer; a parent or guardian signs for a child
steps.result: not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Health questions on the secure page
steps.result: the booking goes on; any yes is read by the instructor before the lesson, on the secure page

steps.name: Surf conditions check
steps.when: by 7am the day of the lesson
steps.result: unsafe surf: the lesson is called off, and the customer picks a new time or a full refund

first_steps_and_forms.prep: a swimsuit, sunscreen, water and a rash guard; arrive 15 minutes early for the board and wetsuit; a photo ID for the first lesson

staff.skills: surf and paddle lessons, kids' lessons, private lessons; the beaches each instructor knows; children's lessons only with instructors the owner says may teach children
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor's lifeguard or first-aid card, the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
staff.who_oks: Sam OKs beach parties, private add-ons and refunds
staff.stand_in: another instructor who knows the beach and the lesson; a private customer who named an instructor is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
staff.ratio: up to 8 surfers per instructor; children's lessons at 4 per instructor

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child under 18 (children 8 to 12 in group lessons; teens 13 to 17 with a guardian's OK); children under 8 are booked with a parent on the sand
children_and_age.minors_texts: texts go to the parent or guardian who booked
children_and_age.minors_rules: children with a parent or guardian on the booking; a child is never left with staff without the parent's OK on file

visit.check_in: the instructor ticks each surfer at the beach stand, or takes each surfer's own code
visit.done: the instructor texts DONE at the end of the lesson
visit.changes_at_visit: an extra hour or a private add-on is priced first, and the surfer says yes; nothing is added to a group lesson

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none from the state for surf lessons in most places; each instructor holds a current lifeguard or first-aid card the business says is current; where a city or park permits commercial lessons on its beach, the permit is the business's own word, shown only once the owner says it is on file
license.who: the business, for its registration and any beach permit; each instructor, for their own lifeguard or first-aid card
license.ask: the business registration; any beach permit, with the beaches and dates it covers; each instructor's card and its end date
license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent
license.background: background checks for instructors who teach children, where the rules ask: the business's own word

never_in_a_text: health notes, injuries, a child's name and age in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
